rationale: TIMB has gapped down ~11% with no news catalyst in the last 24 hours, creating extreme uncertainty about the fundamental driver — without knowing the cause, neither a mean-reversion long nor a continuation short has a reliable edge. The price is sitting at 28% of today's wide range (~$2.30 wide vs. normal ATR of ~$0.11), indicating violent intraday volatility that makes stop placement unreliable. With two working orders already consuming 5% of buying power and no clear directional signal, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure here.
